title: Flooded Palace Ruins
name: scene_flooded_palace
scene_summary: The ruins of an ancient palace half swallowed by cold murky water, collapsed from above: a flooded vestibule, a library, a throne hall and a small round treasury, each deeper in the water than the last.
render_details: Dark stone furred with green weed, cold murky green-brown water with a dull sheen, fallen slabs of stone, drowned timber and swollen books floating, tarnished gold, mould-blackened red cloth, pale daylight falling through the broken vault above

rooms.label: Flooded Vestibule
rooms.description: A vast entrance hall with half its floor under knee-deep water that catches the pale light falling through the broken vault above, colossal stone kings standing along both side walls and two of them fallen full length into the water.

rooms.label: Royal Library
rooms.description: A huge library standing in waist-deep water, tall bookcases along the walls with their books ruined, several cases fallen over into the water and leaning against each other to make narrow passages between them.

rooms.label: Throne Hall
rooms.description: An enormous hall in chest-deep water, tall columns down both sides with mould-blackened red banners hung between them, and deep pools either side of a raised stone causeway running up its length.

rooms.label: Treasury
rooms.description: A small round chamber with the water almost covering its floor, a stone pedestal standing at its centre and empty statue niches set around its wall.

annotations.label: Vestibule Water
annotations.description: Cold murky water filling this whole rectangle from edge to edge, knee deep, its dull surface reflecting the pale daylight, with broken furniture and swollen books floating on it

annotations.label: Fountain Island
annotations.description: A round stone dais standing clear above the water in the middle of the vestibule with a broken fountain on it, water still seeping from a crack in its base and running down into the flood

annotations.label: Grand Stair
annotations.description: A broad stone stair running up out of the water, seen from directly above as straight pale bands one behind the next, its lowest treads under water and slick with weed

annotations.label: Golden Doors
annotations.description: A pair of enormous gilded double doors, one of them torn off its hinges and leaning into the water, leaving a wide opening between them

annotations.label: Dry Reading Table
annotations.description: A long stone table standing above the water down the middle of the library, one patch of its top still dry, a single book lying open on that dry patch

annotations.label: Broken Balcony
annotations.description: A ruined stone ledge running along the library wall clear of the water, seen from straight above as a narrow shelf with its rail fallen away, the tops of the bookcases close enough beside it to climb across to

annotations.label: Small Iron Door
annotations.description: A small rusted iron door low in the far corner of the library, closed, seen from straight above as a flat panel flush with the wall

annotations.label: Throne Causeway
annotations.description: A raised stone causeway running up the middle of the throne hall, its top standing just clear of the water, with deep dark pools on both sides of it

annotations.label: The Throne
annotations.description: A stone throne on a platform of three steps at the head of the causeway, with a broken round opening through the wall behind it, its glass gone, water spilling in across the floor from it

annotations.label: Treasure Pedestal
annotations.description: A massive stone pedestal standing in the middle of the round chamber with an open chest on top of it spilling gold coins, gems and old jewellery, four columns standing around it with heavy chains slung between them

annotations.label: Flooded Grate
annotations.description: A heavy iron grate set into the far wall with a dark water-filled tunnel behind it, the water passing between its bars
